evidence.title: GitHub - axadrn/shadcn-templ: A set of beautifully-designed, accessible components and a code distribution platform. Works with Go and templ. Open Source. Open Code. · GitHub

name: shadcn-templ
summary: Go and templ port of shadcn/ui: 60+ accessible components installed as copy-paste code from a shadcn-format registry and CLI.
description: Unofficial community port of shadcn/ui for Go and templ (previously templUI), now on 2.0 beta docs. The library lists 60+ components — accordion, alert dialog, carousel, chart, command, date picker, drawer, menubar, message, navigation menu, sheet, sidebar, slider, spinner, switch, table, tabs, toast, tooltip and more — alongside blocks, charts, typeset pages and a project creator. Components install as Go/templ copy-paste code through a shadcn-format registry (83 items) and CLI.
contains: 60+ components from accordion and alert dialog to table, toast and tooltip
installs as copy-paste Go/templ code via the shadcn CLI
docs: introduction, components, installation, theming, CLI, typeset, registry, changelog
also ships blocks, charts, typeset and a Create project creator
2.0 beta docs; templUI v1 docs still available
